body:
How I harvest the lactucarium from the wild lettuces, L. Virosa, L. Canadensis and L. Seriola.
1.Grab a flat disk or plate
2.A scraper
3.Find some wild lettuce
4.Cut the stem, starting from the top, moving to the bottom. Around 2-4 cuts will make almost all the sap flow from the roots.
5.Collect the juice on the disk and let it dry, till it turns brown and solid.
6.Scrape it off and smoke it.
It looks and feels exactly like hash. I roll it into a line and put it inside a joint.
P.S The plants regrow super fast, so I don't worry about damaging them. I am just conscious about it!
